Fresh 30-day Developer scratch org. Synthetic Account and Contact records were inserted by each anonymous Apex probe. At each API version, Flow metadata was deployed with partial-success enabled; accepted and rejected components are recorded individually. The Boolean probe uses the available Contact IsEmailBounced field; those components were redeployed after the field was selected. Each accepted Flow ran at its matching API version with a populated input; lookup collections also ran empty. Batches that hit an uncatchable Salesforce system error were repeated as individual transactions; the volatile system error instance identifiers are omitted. The probe source and deployed metadata are adjacent. The scratch org was deleted after capture and deletion verified.
